notes: docs/settings.md: PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR relocates the DEFAULT profile's agent dir (config.yml + agent data). Named profiles derive their own dir and IGNORE it, so do not use --profile with this layout.
models file is models.yml (YAML) for omp vs models.json for pi: payloads are per-harness, never shared.
Skills (Agent Skills spec) and AGENTS.md role text ARE shared with pi personas via shared/.
